Notes: CS2's own knife viewmodel animation. Bone names are CS2's; the CS:MC rig is not involved and nothing is retargeted. The mesh is not described here: every knife is one skinned mesh whose moving parts ride bones in this same skeleton, so it ships through cs2_glb_to_skinned.py like the arms, and MeshParts/Bindings - which exist for the guns' rigid pieces - are deliberately empty.
